title: About
description: Git-native tracker in the spirit of Linear — tasks live next to branches, PRs, and builds. Open-source portfolio project.

kanban.title: Git Kanban
kanban.body: Columns, labels, filters, subtasks, and branch names like feature/TASK-123-login.

git.title: In-app Git
git.body: Link a branch or PR, review diffs, open and merge — without leaving the board.

cicd.title: CI/CD dashboard
cicd.body: GitHub Actions per branch: status, jobs, and streaming logs while builds run.

sprints.title: Sprints & backlog
sprints.body: Board-scoped sprints with estimates, close flows, and velocity insights.

teams.title: Teams & permissions
teams.body: Team → Project roles, invites, and GitHub repo connect with multi-board setup.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.body: Rich text, comments, @mentions, Watch, and a live activity feed.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.body: Ctrl/Cmd+K to search, create, jump boards/CI, and switch projects.

guest.title: Guest Mode
guest.body: Demo without OAuth — local sandbox with tasks, fake diffs, and CI logs.

stack: Vite · React 19 · TanStack Router & Query · Tailwind 4 · shadcn/ui · Supabase · GitHub API
